svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: understand-the-wire infrastructure architecture
svg.desc: A Terraform-provisioned AWS environment in eu-central-1: Cloudflare DNS resolves two hostnames to a public Application Load Balancer, which terminates TLS with an ACM certificate and forwards HTTP to a single EC2 instance in a private subnet running single-node k3s. Flux, bootstrapped from EC2 user_data using a GitHub token read from SSM Parameter Store, pulls manifests from GitHub and reconciles the frontend and kube-prometheus-stack workloads. Egress leaves through a NAT gateway; operator access is via SSM Session Manager over VPC interface endpoints, with no SSH and no public IP on the node.
